_style: Bright, vivid 3D animated-film illustration for a children's quiz app, rich colour, soft cinematic light, clean composition. Portrait 3:4. The main subject sits in the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower third is calmer and a little darker (text is laid over it). No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no speech bubbles.
_note: One picture per fun fact in facts.js, keyed by the fact id (world-index, index from 0). Rendered with gpt-image-2 into assets/facts/<id>.jpg (600x800). Regenerate one by editing its prompt and rerunning it.
